evidence_categories.formally-proved-under-stated-assumptions: Separate formal_proof artifacts and checked receipt bound to exact claim context; passing tests never imply this category.
evidence_categories.independently-reviewed: Separate independent_review artifacts and reviewer/independence/source/scope receipt; authored reviewed status requires it.

measurement_contract.raw_repetitions: Retain every attempted repetition and reason, including failed/skipped/timeout/OOM. Record seed/repetition policy and exact input/claim/relation/backend/security-mode IDs.
measurement_contract.setup: Separate cold/cached/reused setup, preprocessing and amortization policy.
measurement_contract.units: Name units per metric, distinguish wall/CPU time and peak/resident memory; include hardware/toolchain/locks.
measurement_contract.statistics: Name statistic, uncertainty procedure and sample count; never invent variance/confidence from one trial.
measurement_contract.security_mode: Identify public/private witnesses, setup trust, cohort/collusion/noise/release assumptions and unsupported capabilities.
measurement_contract.not_run: No fabricated zero timing or successful skipped proof. Preserve unavailable-adapter reasons and negative results.

publication.approved_false: Permitted for truthful local/private records; prohibit publication/export of the bundle until exact digest-bound artifacts receive authorized review.
publication.raw_inputs: Never include private records/witnesses, model/data commitment openings, secret randomness, private paths or restricted source bytes.
publication.review: Record reviewer, scope, date and exact artifact hashes; approval boolean alone is insufficient.
publication.retention: Archive approved evidence and digests independently of expiring hosted logs; follow RELEASING.md.

result_compatibility.review: S03 reviewed schema changes for metadata truthfulness, not renderer/policy integration or scientific validation. S04 must run canonical schema/renderer/publication tests.
candidate_requirements: local execution has null workflow_path and workflow_run, execution_kind=local
github-actions execution has a real positive workflow run ID and supported workflow path
phase expansion must preserve raw/summary identity and unit validation
bundle validator resolves result versions locally and rejects unknown versions
result_compatibility.ci_14_to_25: pending-specification; no published contracts found in audit 2026-11-24
